thread:
elaine: @here Quick GA update — we are promoting Stable Streaming v1.2 (adaptive routing + tool-calling improvements) to hosted production today at 17:00 PT. This release consolidates the streaming stack, adds adaptive-region routing for lower p95 latency, and formalizes tool-calling semantics for the hosted API. Docs & changelog: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/stable-streaming-1-2 :tada:
chris: Awesome — does this require SDK changes?
elaine: SDKs get a minor bump (js/py 0.12.x -> 0.13.x). Backwards compat for basic streaming kept, but tool-calling helpers are new. We recommend customers upgrade within 30 days.
ops-bot: Deploy window: 17:00–18:30 PT. Rolling across regions (us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1). Health checks enabled.
marco: Heads up for Dedicated customers: if you use pinned model variants, check the routing policy toggle before the roll — otherwise you may not see adaptive routing benefits.
elaine: Good call. We'll email Dedicated contacts with a toggle guide. Also, note new default rate-limit policy for streaming connections (to reduce noisy neighbors): 60 concurrent streams per org by default, adjustable via support request.
cto_jane: Will we preserve the old streaming endpoints?
elaine: Yes — the legacy streaming endpoints (/v1/streams/legacy) will be supported for 90 days post-GA. After that they'll be deprecated; customers get a migration tool and an opt-in extended-support option.
eng_prod: Migration checklist draft: 1) Upgrade SDK 2) Test tool-calls in staging 3) Verify region routing w/ canary keys 4) Run load test. I'll drop a checklist link in 10m.
chris: For observability — will Console show per-stream latency + region breakdown?
elaine: Yes, Console now has a "Streaming" tab with token-level cost, per-region p50/p95/p99, and a fallback-count metric (how often adaptive routing falls back to a different model/region).
ops-bot: Note: SRE has created a burn-in job in prod to exercise KV-cache interactions during the rollout. Alerts: streaming-err-rate > 0.5% and p95 latency > 350ms will auto-pause rollout.
marco: Any special instructions for customers using function/tool calling with external webhooks?
elaine: If you use external webhooks, confirm your callback domains are whitelisted in the new tool-calling config. We added a stricter validation step to avoid webhook abuse.
chris: Sample curl for new tool-calling (for docs):
chris: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "redwood-stable-1.2", "tools": [{"name":"weather","url":"https://hooks.example.com/weather"}], "stream": true}'
```
elaine: If you run into any breakage during the window ping #eng-oncall and tag @ops-bot. We're planning a post-mortem thread in #product if anything user-impacting occurs.
cto_jane: Great work team. Let's monitor SLAs closely this week and share an exec digest tomorrow. :eyes:
